item.title: איום הטרור באירופה גובר, איראנים נעצרו בלונדון: "ריגלו אחר יהודים"
item.description: ארבעה איראנים עקבו אחרי מוסדות וחברי הקהילה היהודית בלונדון, ונעצרו בחשד לריגול. דובר המשטרה האירופית חושש כי למלחמה באיראן יהיו השלכות מיידיות על ביטחון היבשת, ומזהיר מקבוצות שתומכות באיראן שינסו לבצע פיגועים

item.title: 'Disgraceful': Trump blasts Herzog again, urges president to pardon Netanyahu 'today'
item.description: US president says Isaac Herzog promised him five times to grant clemency to PM and warns Israeli leader should face no distractions except Iran war

item.title: Watch: Iranian TV reporter flees live on air as Israeli strike hits again
item.description: State broadcaster correspondent reporting from a bombed neighborhood in Tehran interrupted by fresh explosions during live broadcast as Israel carries out its 14th wave of strikes on the capital and US-Israeli attacks expand across Iran

item.title: Wave of strikes in Beirut’s Dahieh; US says B-2 bombers hit underground missile sites, 30 Iranian vessels sunk
item.description: US says B-2 bombers struck Iran’s underground missile facilities as Israeli airstrikes pounded Beirut’s Dahieh; Iranian vessels reported sunk and regional tensions escalate

item.title: Sirens sound in central Israel; IAF official says Israel aims for near-normal life within days
item.description: A senior Israeli Air Force officer says Israel aims to restore near-normal daily life within days while maintaining sustained strikes deep inside Iran and continuing efforts to weaken the country’s missile capabilities

item.title: Iran missiles, Hezbollah drones: IDF sees split strategy against Israel
item.description: Israel eased some Home Front Command restrictions as missile launches from Iran decline; workplaces can reopen and gatherings of up to 50 people are allowed, but officials warn the threat remains and urge the public to follow shelter instructions

item.title: 'Target is down': IDF releases cockpit footage of F-35 downing Iranian jet over Tehran | Watch
item.description: The dogfight marks the first known time an F-35 has downed an enemy aircraft and the first aerial kill by the Israeli Air Force since the late 1980s

item.title: Missile from Iran hits open area in central Israel, no injuries reported
item.description: The IDF said the number of missile launches from Iran appears to be declining, though authorities remain on alert for possible developments involving the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen

item.title: Over 3,000 Iranian soldiers and operatives killed since start of war, Israeli officials say
item.description: Officials say the air force has dropped about 5,500 munitions across Iran and carried out 12 major strike missions over Tehran, destroying missile sites, command centers and air defenses as part of a phased campaign with the United States

item.title: Israel targets Hamas figure in north Lebanon as Iranian launches trigger sirens in Israel
item.description: Strike on an apartment in the Beddawi refugee camp in Tripoli, reportedly aimed at a Hamas figure, as Iranian missile launches trigger explosions across central Israel and Israeli forces hit Hezbollah infrastructure in Beirut’s Dahieh district
